verdict.outcome_rationale: This is a genuine agent-fault failure where the verifier correctly rejected the submission: the harness computed hidden-test R²=0.989226 and gated binary_reward to 0 because that score does not exceed the 0.995 threshold [1][2]. The task asked the agent to discover a vocabulary scaling law in `/app/law.py` and `/app/explain.md` that extrapolates to held-out points [3], and the bundled reference form is the simple inverse-power law L(N,V,D)=A/N^α+B/V^β+C/D^γ+E [4]. The agent instead delivered a much richer log-domain power law with a fitted characters-per-token conversion and a ridge quadratic residual correction [5], after systematically exploring the 1080-point 6×9×20 training grid and running leave-one-axis cross-validation on training vocabularies only (leave-V mean RMSE ≈0.055) [6][7]. That work produced excellent in-sample fit (training RMSE ≈0.053) [8], but the agent treated `py_compile` success as “validation passed” without ever measuring performance on the held-out test split [9][10], and on that hidden 120-point test set the law achieved only R²≈0.989 [2]. The submission therefore falls short of the task’s extrapolation gate even though it outperforms the reference solution (R²≈0.966 on the same hidden test in independent reproduction), so TN is appropriate: verifier FAIL and the agent did not truly meet the required extrapolation standard.
